decisions.decision: Fixed comment notification refId to store post._id/'Post' instead of comment._id/'Comment'
decisions.rationale: Notification card navigation needs to load the post the comment was made on, not the comment document itself — root-caused via refId/refModel data flow tracing from creation site to navigate() call

decisions.decision: Fixed follow_request/follow_accepted notification navigation to use populated actorId._id instead of refId
decisions.rationale: refId pointed at the Follow junction document, not the User — populated actorId already carries the correct user reference for navigation
